lines.t: A voice breaks the silence of night
Calling hearts to awaken in light
Rouse from your slumber, the heavens cry
For the king draws near, salvation nigh
He comes in garments pure and bright
Justice blazing, dressed in white
Have we heard him? Have we known?
The son of mercy claims his own
Awaken, our hearts are burning
The tide of love returning
Every word, a holy flame
Echoes the power of his name
The heavens tremble, the earth bows low
All creation longs to know
The bridegroom comes in glory true
Lift your eyes
The king breaks through
We've heard the rhythm of his grace
The sound of mercy fills this place
It beats within the Father's chest
Where all the weary come to rest
Strong and gentle, my arms surround
In perfect love, his heart is found
Can you feel it deep inside?
The call of heaven now amplified
Awaken, our hearts are burning
The tide of love returning
Every word, a holy flame
Echoes the power of his name
The heavens tremble, the earth bows low
Our creation longs to know
The bridegroom comes in glory through
Lift our eyes, the king breaks through
Let every soul arise and sing
Put death away before the king
For love and self is drawing near
The sound of triumph fills the sphere
We cry aloud
Our spirits soar
The bright groomer stands at heaven's door
Awaken, our hearts are burning
The sun of grace returning
Every word of truth renews
The faith our hearts once nearly lose
The heavens thunder, the trumpet calls
The king of glory reigns on all
Awaken hearts
The light breaks through
Your king comes to you
Thanks for watching!
